review: Builds evidence-rich escalation briefs with customer impact, reproduction steps, prior attempts, accountable teams, deadlines and follow-up. Native routing supports churn threats and blocked customers, extending Riley into practical customer advocacy.
native_prerequisites: Use the author-defined tool categories for connected CRM/support/knowledge/email/chat sources; supply accessible records and actual account context. No placeholder text replacement is required.
